items.title: Mbappe scores twice as Real Madrid beat Sevilla
items.summary: Kylian Mbappe scores twice as Real Madrid beat Sevilla 4-1 in La Liga to close the gap on Barcelona to six points ahead of next weekend's El Clasico.
